verdict.rationale: Copilot documents an admin control for exactly this story: leads can control which MCP servers developers can reach from their IDEs, using allow lists, and agents are governed from a single control plane. The evidence covers only MCP servers in the IDE context, with a one-line marketing claim and no detailed docs. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the allow-list configuration, evidence that the controls extend to non-MCP tools/integrations and to the cloud agent and CLI surfaces, per-tool granularity, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can control which external tools and integrations the agent is allowed to access

citations.quote: Control which MCP servers developers can access from their IDEs, and use allow lists to prevent unauthorized access.
enforce governance by managing agents from a single control plane
